title: rhun: a small, fast code editor written in assembly
excerpt: A small, fast code editor for Windows, Linux and macOS. Written in assembly.
content_html:
AI does the heavy lifting. Keep your code editor light.

Less weight. More flow.

A small, fast code editor. Written in assembly.

Explore rhun

Tabs, syntax highlighting, fuzzy search, and optional Vim mode.

Terminal install · Linux & macOS

curl -fsSL https://github.com/vshvedov/rhun/releases/latest/download/install.sh | sh

Windows: Download the ZIP, extract it, and open rhun.exe.
